name: Myanmar National Building Code 2020 (MNBC)
description: A thin pack for Myanmar (alpha 9 track C23): MNBC 2020 Part 3 designs in the IBC / ASCE 7 and ACI 318 form, so it extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22 and sets what MNBC changes. Seismic: the towns' mapped SS and S1 (with the MNBC zone for information) and the site coefficients Fa and Fv of site classes A-F, SDS = 2/3 Fa SS and SD1 = 2/3 Fv S1 (a generic option of the mapped spectral method; a project's own SS, S1 or SDS, SD1 take precedence), the two-period spectrum, Cs and the Seismic Design Category of the parent. Wind: the 50-year basic wind speed (3-second gust) by town, the ASCE 7-05 form exposure constants and wind importance factors, with the 1.6W / 1.0W load combinations of the ASCE 7-05 Sec 2.3.2 / 2.4.1 form. Metric bars (10-32 mm) with BS 8666 schedules; SI units. Concrete (ACI 318-19), steel (AISC 360-22), the live loads and the rest are the parent's. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md: the towns' SS, S1 and wind speeds are SAEngine estimates by zone and region, to be replaced with the MNBC tables' values before design.
